snippet.title: KUROMAKU Demo | Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
“After the divorce, I thought the worst was over… but I was wrong.”

Step into the unsettling world of Kuromaku, a slow-burn psychological horror experience set in the intimate, suffocating space of your father’s apartment. Uncover hidden truths, piece together fractured memories, and survive the creeping presence that lurks just beyond the edge of your vision.

Will you find the answers you’re searching for… or will the apartment claim you too?

🕯 Releasing soon on Steam – Wishlist now and be ready when the door opens.
